_doc: MISUMI's pre-assembly insertion nut (HNTT6) for its 6 series, 8 mm slot, M5. The standard nut: slid in from an open end before the frame is closed. Hold: MISUMI gives a tightening torque, not a pull.
name: slot-nut-8-misumi-m5-slide-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 6 series (slot width 8 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M5, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5, M6)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

nut_kind.rule: A plain block with a tongue, slid in from the end of the slot
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot: 14 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot: 15 on the drawing
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: 5.5 on the drawing (6.3 overall)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: the drawing's overall height less the body's
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Pre-assembly insertion: slid in from an open end of the slot before the frame is closed
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-619, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_619.pdf

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its sliding block in an 8 mm slot (M8) at 6000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
